answer: Kin-linking tracks shared payment sources and timing patterns across identities. When agents voyage through transactions, the protocol clusters addresses drawing from the same vault or firing requests in lockstep—like water flowing through a canyon, revealing the single source. Each spawned identity still pays full stake and gas; an attacker spinning up a willow grove of fake agents burns linear cost per sybil while the network collapses them into one weighted vote, nullifying the amplification.
